svg.title: Fitted LuCa marker distributions and increasing component scores
svg.desc: Both columns use the same 1173 measured LuCa whole-cell PDL1 intensities. The Gaussian fit has separate variances; the Gamma parameters are retained from the production fit. The top row shows the original 256-bin histogram, weighted component densities and their sum. The middle row shows raw higher-mean responsibilities over intensities zero to six, including their low-intensity minima. The bottom row overlays the raw responsibility and production increasing score over intensities zero to nine. The correction uses 1172 distinct observed intensities and endpoint clipping. At score cutoff 0.5 the Gaussian gate is 3.195921779415409 and the Gamma gate is 1.270020530102121. Fitted-function evaluations below the observed minimum are extrapolations. These component scores have not been calibrated against biological labels.
